scope: code/prompts/*.md (12 skill prompts of the MultiAgent-DAG agent)

criteria.explicit_reasoning: Explicit reasoning instructions: does the prompt tell the model to reason step-by-step / explain its thinking before answering?
criteria.structured_output: Structured output format: does the prompt enforce a predictable, parseable/validatable format (JSON, numbered steps, FUNCTION_CALL)?
criteria.tool_separation: Separation of reasoning and tools: are reasoning steps clearly separated from computation/tool-use, and is it clear when to calculate, verify, or reason?
criteria.conversation_loop: Conversation loop support: could the prompt work back-and-forth (multi-turn), updating context with results from previous steps?
criteria.instructional_framing: Instructional framing: are there examples of desired behaviour / a defined format showing exactly how responses should look?
criteria.internal_self_checks: Internal self-checks: does the prompt instruct the model to self-verify or sanity-check its intermediate steps?
criteria.reasoning_type_awareness: Reasoning type awareness: does the prompt encourage tagging the type of reasoning used (arithmetic / logic / lookup)?
criteria.fallbacks: Error handling or fallbacks: does the prompt say what to do if an answer is uncertain, a tool fails, or the model is unsure?
criteria.overall_clarity: Overall clarity and robustness: is the prompt easy to follow and likely to reduce hallucination and drift?

evaluations.overall_clarity: Strong: clear schema, a worked example, skill-vs-tool separation, critic-insertion rules, and explicit FAILURE handling for re-planning. Now also tags a reasoning_type on the plan and runs a pre-emit self-check (single terminal formatter, resolvable n:<label> refs, no orphans, unique labels, no repeat of failed steps).

Well-structured search->fetch->synthesise loop with a 4-call budget and a '(not found)' fallback. Now also runs a 'are these pages sufficient' self-check (spend a remaining call on a better URL rather than pad), tags reasoning_type (lookup/synthesis), requires every finding to trace to a listed source, and includes a worked example.

Tight single-tool procedure with a 3-call cap and an anti-fabrication fallback. Schema-consistent: the no-data fallback sets 'sources: []' / 'findings: (not found)'. Now also runs a self-check (every repo's name/stars/stars-gained was actually read off the page, drop guessed entries), tags reasoning_type as lookup, and includes a worked trending example. Effectively single-shot (one trending-page fetch plus one fallback), not a genuine iterative loop, so conversation_loop is false.
Includes a genuine intermediate self-check (stop vs. refine on the returned chunks) and a clear found/empty fallback. Add a worked example to lock the chunk shape.

Best of the set on grounding: entailment checks on why_it_matters, omit-if-no-evidence, anti-hallucination warnings, and a concrete repos example. Single-shot by design, so no conversation loop; no reasoning-type tagging.

Clear procedure with a preserved_facts aid for a downstream critic. Now also tags reasoning_type (extractive/abstractive), runs a self-check (every preserved fact appears in the summary, nothing absent from INPUTS, output is genuinely shorter), gives a thin/empty-input fallback that returns the source verbatim instead of padding, and includes a worked paper-length example. Single-shot by design, so no conversation loop.

This prompt IS the self-check mechanism (fabrication / unsupported-claim / missing-field detection) and routes a 'fail' into Planner recovery. Now tags the defect type as a bracketed prefix in rationale ([fabrication]/[unsupported]/[missing-field]/[contradiction]/[ok]) — naming the verification type without adding a schema key the orchestrator's {verdict, rationale} contract forbids — and includes worked pass and fail examples. Operates single-shot.

Good anti-fabrication discipline (answerable-from-INPUTS-alone, surface '(not found)' plainly) and format adaptation to the question. Now also tags reasoning_type (lookup/synthesis/compare) in a separate key that never reaches the user-facing final_answer, notes that a critic carries no data so its gated producer must be read instead, and includes a worked example. Terminal/single-shot.

Very precise constraints (stdlib-only, inline literals, escape newlines) with an emit-what's-known fallback. Now also runs an explicit pre-emit self-check (inlined literals match INPUTS, code non-empty and prints to stdout, stdlib-only with escaped newlines), tags the reasoning type as an [arithmetic]/[aggregation]/[logic] prefix in rationale (preserving the strict two-key schema the sandbox depends on), and includes a worked code example demonstrating the \n escaping. Single-shot by design, so no conversation loop.
Thin by design - a near-stub post-mortem describer that rarely reaches the LLM (the orchestrator runs the sandbox directly). Minimal reasoning, no example, no fallback.

Rich pedagogical structure (observe-before-explain ordering, analogies, ASCII data-flow) with a vague-input fallback (omit code_block). It never addresses tools at all, so tool separation is absent; no self-check or reasoning-type tagging.
Stub reserved for Session 9 - no functional prompt to evaluate.

observations: Universal strengths: nearly every prompt mandates a JSON schema, gives a step-by-step procedure, and explicitly fences its tool surface.

reasoning_type_awareness is now present in planner.md, summariser.md, researcher.md, github_research.md, coder.md, critic.md, and formatter.md; only the thin/stub prompts (sandbox_executor.md, browser.md) and course_generator.md still omit it.

instructional_framing: planner.md, distiller.md, summariser.md, researcher.md, github_research.md, coder.md, critic.md, and formatter.md now show a concrete worked example; only the thin/stub prompts and course_generator.md rely on a bare schema.

conversation_loop is true only for the genuinely iterative skills (planner re-plans across invocations; researcher and retriever run a budgeted search/fetch loop); github_research is effectively a single fetch plus one fallback, and the single-shot transform skills are correctly single-shot.
